name: ob-swift-figma
output_contract: Integrated UIKit Swift onboarding code inside the existing GeneralOB architecture, with required preflights, one-to-one page mapping, announcement compliance, persisted selection where applicable, namespaced assets, focused per-page evidence, page-specific commits, and one final workspace/project scheme build. Queue and BaseCell behavior follow their routed reference without modifying unrelated user work.
execution_policy: Always load core-workflow; lazily load queue, BaseCell, page, option, and asset/verification references independently. Missing BaseCell does not load or gate on BaseCell rules. Each eligible queue page owns one isolated agent/worktree/commit; the parent owns status markers, ordered integration, and the final build.
agent_dispatch: Parse the queue before dispatch. Serial mode runs one page at a time. Concurrent mode runs document-ordered batches of up to three isolated page agents and integrates the complete batch in order.
parallel_execution_policy: Opening 是否并发完成执行 true runs three eligible pages concurrently, or the remaining count below three; false or missing is serial. Invalid/conflicting values stop dispatch. BaseCell consumes no page-agent slot.
base_cell_section_policy: BaseCell is optional. Absence is valid and skips BaseCell evidence and shared edits. When present, it is not a page: update only the existing GeneralOBBaseCell, GeneralOBVC.nextButton, GeneralOB namespace metadata, and 44 pt GeneralOB/icon_back PNGs; put unselected UI in baseView and selected container effects in selectedBaseView.
circle_progress_control: Use GeneralOBCircleProgress with cx390(14), #0F172A0D, and #9E95FC/#5E7BFB unless the page announcement overrides it.
collection_section_policy: CollectionSection uses GeneralOBCollectionSectionVC, the OBSleepVC super.registerCell/path.item > 0/super.cell fallback, and sectionDetail(sec:) with real expanded information.
notes: Detailed runtime rules are lazy-loaded from focused references; implementation-workflow.md is a compatibility index and output-risk-profile.md is audit-only.
No external benchmark scan was run; treat that as missing evidence before broader distribution.
